pages.ja:
ライダーを見捨てておけない。
左腕の痛み、削られていく記憶をかみ殺し、
アゾット剣を引き抜きながら、黒い剣士へ疾走した。
pages.jaRuby:

左腕の痛み、削られていく記憶をかみ殺し、
アゾット剣を引き抜きながら、黒い剣士へ疾走した。
pages.en:
——I can't abandon Rider.

Biting back the pain in my left arm and the memories being stripped away, I draw the Azoth Sword and charge the black swordswoman.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I can’t just abandon Rider.
I bear the pain and the shredding memory.
I pull out the Azoth Sword and run to the black swordsman.

pages.ja:
決断が迅速なら、行動も迅速だった。
地を蹴る足は爆弾みたいに強力で、
宙を跳ぶ体は弾丸のように速い。
pages.jaRuby:
決断が迅速なら、行動も迅速だった。
地を蹴る足は爆弾みたいに強力で、
宙を跳ぶ体は弾丸のように速い。
pages.en:
The decision was swift, and my body is swifter.

The foot that drives me from the ground has the force of a bomb.

My body flies through the air like a bullet.
pages.mirrorMoon:
If my determination was quick, my action was quick as well.
My legs are strong as an explosion,
and my body’s fast as a bullet.

pages.ja: 逆流する血液。逆流する感覚。逆流する毒素。
pages.jaRuby: 逆流する血液。逆流する感覚。逆流する毒素。
pages.en: Blood flows backward. Sensation flows backward. Poison flows backward.
pages.mirrorMoon: Regurgitation of blood, backflow of my senses, backflow of poison.

pages.ja:
左腕と肉体が一体化する。
戦士として未熟な衛宮士郎が、卓絶した超人へ変貌する。
pages.jaRuby:
左腕と肉体が一体化する。
戦士として未熟な衛宮士郎が、卓絶した超人へ変貌する。
pages.en:
The left arm merges with my body.

Shirou Emiya, an untrained warrior, transforms into a peerless superhuman.
pages.mirrorMoon:
My left arm and my body become one.
An inexperienced warrior named Emiya Shirou turns into a supreme super being.

I cut in from the side between the two figures in black.

“——Shirou…!?”

Rider is down on one knee.

“————————”

Saber can respond to me with nothing but her eyes.

pages.en:
“——Wha—”

It shatters.

The blade that should have buried itself in Saber's body splinters the instant it touches her.

Her returning strike comes at the speed of light.

It shears through me.

Just as I intended, the severed mass goes tumbling hideously away.

“Wha”

The sword that should’ve
cut through Saber’s arm
pierced Saber’s flesh
shatters at the moment of contact.
At the speed of light, the counterattack comes.
An arm flies off.
A severed left arm
It
rolls across the ground, just as I planned.

Rider springs back. Saber stands unmoved.

“Ah——aah, gah…………!”

I fall to my knees and desperately press my empty hand against the blood pouring from my left shoulder.

“Hah… ngh, gh, aaaaaah…………!”

I writhe upon the ground.

“It is not that I failed to react. There was no need for me to react, Shirou.”

The black swordswoman speaks without emotion.

Footsteps draw near.

She comes to my defenseless back, my back, and—

ですが

pages.en:
“I have pulled your fangs. …Sakura will not say it aloud, but she wishes you to live. If I could render you helpless without killing you, her wish was that I bring you before her.

“However——”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Now you have lost your weapon. …Sakura does not say it, but she wishes you to live. I am to take you to her if I am able to neutralize you before you die.
But”

pages.ja:
剣の切っ先が背中を抉る。
わずか数センチ、一押しするだけで心臓を穿つ、冷酷な死の重み。
pages.jaRuby:
剣の切っ先が背中を抉る。

pages.en:
The point of her sword gouges into my back.

It need move only a few centimeters to pierce my heart: the merciless weight of death.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The tip of her sword pricks my spine.
A cold weight of death, able to pierce my heart with one push.

pages.ja:
「……選びなさい。ここで私の剣にかかるか、死以上の死を桜に与えられるか。どちらを取るかは貴方次第です、シロウ」
……意識が遠くなっていく。
流れていく血液と、背中に当てられた刃の重さ。
pages.jaRuby:
「……選びなさい。ここで私の剣にかかるか、死以上の死を桜に与えられるか。どちらを取るかは貴方次第です、シロウ」
……意識が遠くなっていく。

pages.en:
“…Choose. Will you die here upon my sword, or allow Sakura to inflict upon you a death beyond death? The choice is yours, Shirou.”

…My consciousness recedes.

Blood draining away. The weight of the blade against my back.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Choose. You can die by my sword or receive a death worse than death from Sakura. The decision is yours, Shirou.”
…I’m losing consciousness.
My blood’s flowing out of me, and a sword is pressed against my back.
